methodSections.heading: Filling
steps: Mix the filling ingredients in a bowl. Add the soy milk gradually and only use enough to form moist yet firm dough.
Roll the peanut butter filling into 2cm (¾in) balls and place in the freezer for roughly 20 minutes to firm up.

methodSections.heading: Dough
steps: Sift the dry dough ingredients into a large bowl and the wet into another.

Create a mound out of the dry ingredients in the bowl and dig a little well in the top. Add the wet ingredients gradually into the well and stir together with a spatula. Allow to rest for around 30 minutes or even overnight.
Line a baking tray with parchment paper and preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).

Scoop a generous tablespoon of cookie dough and flatten it into a disc roughly the size of a coaster and less than 1cm (½in) thick. Place a peanut butter ball in centre of the disc. Mould the sides of chocolate dough around the peanut butter filling completely covering it. Roll into a ball between the palms of your hands.

Place the balls on an oven tray leaving plenty of space for them to flatten. Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and allow to cool completely and become firm. If there’s any filling left over, shape small cookies and bake them too.
